::: {.hero-band style="margin-bottom:1.5rem;"}
# CMS TEAM Impact Report

**Financial field guide** for CMS’s first mandatory **multi-procedure** surgical episode model · **`r m$n_team`** hospitals · **`r m$n_ca`** in California (`r m$n_ca_cbsa` metro areas)

Prepared by Christina Keny, PhD, MHA, RN, CPHQ · Rainfall Health · **July 2026**
:::

## Background

By 2030, every Baby Boomer will be 65 or older, with nearly **`r fmt_n(m$pop_2030 / 1000)`** thousand Americans aged 65+ [@census2023np]. Adults 65+ account for about **`r round(m$pct_surgical_stays_65plus, 1)`%** of inpatient surgical stays with an OR procedure [@hcup2021sb281] — not 40% of all discharges.

Multimorbidity affects roughly 74% of older emergency general surgery patients in a **UK cohort** [@hewitt2016]. Frailty and dementia sharply raise surgical mortality [@gill2022; @tang2020; @deiner2014].

The AAMC projects a shortage of up to **86,000** physicians by **2036**, including up to **19,900** surgeons [@aamc2024]. Average THA/TKA length of stay fell from **3.0** to **1.1** days (2012–2023) [@ajrr2024]; more than half of Medicare TKAs are billed outpatient [@burnett2023].

TEAM holds hospitals accountable for **30-day** episodes [@cms1808f]. **CJR-X** starts **January 1, 2028**, covering **`r fmt_n(m$n_cjrx)`** hospitals [@cms1849f]. About **`r fmt_n(m$n_team + m$n_cjrx)`** hospitals will sit in mandatory episode models by that date.

::: {.callout-note}
**Stat box (computed).** TEAM hospitals: **`r m$n_team`** · CJR-X: **`r fmt_n(m$n_cjrx)`** · 65+ OR-stay share: **`r round(m$pct_surgical_stays_65plus, 1)`%** · Surgery prevalence 65+: **19.4%** [@bicket2024]
:::

## Surgical demand in older adults

Nearly **1 in 5** adults 65+ had surgery in the past year — the highest prevalence of any age group [@bicket2024].

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Figure 2. Age 65+ share by TEAM procedure (HCUP where verified)."

fig2_procedure_age_shares(m)
```

## TEAM mandate

**`r m$n_team`** mandated hospitals · CMS savings target **$481M** over five performance years [@cms1808f]. Up to **`r m$track3_cap_pct`%** of target spending at risk each year (Track 3).

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Figure 3. Average gain vs loss per case (ACS/IAC 2023)."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.8
fig3_per_procedure_swing(root)
```

Advisory Board modeling: **56%** of mandatory participants projected to lose money under current criteria, averaging **$1.2M** each [@advisory2025team]. Five-year exposure above **$14M** is **internal Rainfall analysis** [@rainfall2026model].

## Penalties & incentives

Track 3 applies a flat **±`r m$track3_cap_pct`%** stop-loss/stop-gain on target price **every performance year** [@cms1808f] — not a 30% ramp to PY5.

```{r}
#| fig-cap: "Figure 4. Track 3 corridor (20% each year)."
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.2
fig4_track3_cap(m)
```

PY1 preliminary target prices span **`r fmt_usd(m$tp_min_331)`** (DRG 331 minimum) to **`r fmt_usd(m$tp_max_426)`** (DRG 426 maximum) across regions (CMS TEAM PY1 workbook).

## California

**`r m$n_ca`** mandated hospitals across **`r m$n_ca_cbsa` metro areas** — largest state concentration [@cms1808f]. Region splits: **internal Rainfall analysis** [@rainfall2026cabr].

## Episode economics (internal)

Median five-year impact **`r fmt_usd(internal$california_episode_economics$median_five_year_impact_usd)`**; peak **`r fmt_usd(internal$california_episode_economics$peak_five_year_impact_usd)`** — **internal Rainfall analysis** [@rainfall2026model].

## Rainfall Health platform

San Francisco-based Rainfall Health (CEO Eddie Qureshi; **$15M** Series A, Two Bear Capital, February 2026) [@medcity2026]. **$85M** Medicare revenue projection over five years: **internal Rainfall analysis / CEO statements** [@medcity2026].
